notes.title: Let's all be CALM, play games and prevent suicide
notes.notes: [p]Besides the regular update schedule, this time debris is part of Games Against Living Miserably – CALM's event on Steam. [/p][p]I think games can and should be more than just a way to kill time, so I decided to join CALM on their mission to reduce suicide rates.[/p][p][/p][p]As for the update:[/p][list][*][p]New Upgrade system, to allow upgrading aspects of the drone, regardless of its modules.[/p][/*][*][p]Cut-Scenes now wait for you instead of just going along at their pace.[/p][list][*][p]The dialogs have been revised to give a bit more clarity, albeit a little less realistic.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]There is now a dynamic tutorial for flying and grabbing with the drone.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial for using Station's HUD has been improved by darkening unimportant HUD-modules.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings can now be accessed from within the game, using the current view as a preview for graphic settings.[/p][list][*][p]Music volume can now be changed in the settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that enabled music when opening the settings[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Missons are now clearer labeled[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="buDprkaYtog;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Manual Expansion & UX improvements
notes.notes: [p]This is more of a hot-fix-collection than anything else.[/p][p]The anticipated update to come is already in the making[/p][p][/p][p]More precisely: there were (as expected) many problems with the [b]story system[/b], all of which should now be fixed.[/p][p]The [b]manual was extended[/b] by 4 new pages that explain the interface-elements.[/p][p]I also fixed/tweaked many other small things to make for a nicer expierience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630815/eb1677ad5ec48eba36a1334064f0659c02c2a62d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630815/8b913a4845cc364bf4a0d329f5e81af525b12d12.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Settings and performance
notes.notes:
[p]As promised in the last update, there is now a settings menu. You can access it via the mainmenu.[/p][p]It comes with live preview and a fps counter, to find the correct settings.
(Currently there is just shadow quality, rendering scale and v-sync there).[/p][p]If you like to get the ultimate 80s experience there is a preset for that with pixels large as pancakes.[/p][p]Wenn du die Ultimative 80er Jahre Erfahrung haben möchtest, gibt es dafür auch eine Voreinstellung.[/p][p][/p][p]Changes include:[/p][list][*][p]Video and performance settings[/p][/*][*][p]some further performance improvements, also possible tweaking via the settings[/p][/*][*][p]improvements and tweaks for Modules and their required resources[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Next up:[/p][list][*][p]More graphic settings[/p][/*][*][p]Further performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]improvements for drone movement[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]In the background I will be creating more content for the full release, which means more modules, larger world and more story.[/p]

notes.title: Release Follow-up
notes.notes: [p]This time I have some quality of life improvements and fixes – small but important changes.[/p][p]The changes include:[/p][list][*][p]Music can now be muted via BigScreen™[/p][/*][*][p]Controls shown in the manual can be rebinded to support broken keys, favorite layouts and enhanced accessibility[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes for Station and drone Editor[/p][/*][*][p]Small performance tweaks, the game should now run better on lower end hardware[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes for Resource extractor, correctly handling 4+ resource types and not stopping after every type.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Next up:[/p][list][*][p]focus on performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]improvements and tweaks for Modules and their required resources[/p][/*][*][p]Video and performance settings[/p][/*][*][p]improvements for drone movement[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
[p]After some all-nighters the first public version of debris is now available! 🎉[/p][p]There are still many things that need to be improved and many more ideas for more content – but for now I am looking forward to your feedback.

Limitations of the Demo version are:[/p][list][*][p]Progress cannot be saved[/p][/*][*][p]Total playtime is around 30 minutes to an hour[/p][/*][*][p]limited number of modules[/p][/*][*][p]limited story[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks to all the people that already tried it, your feedback was very valuable and I am looking forward to getting your feedback in the future as well![/p][p][/p][p]Changes compared to last time include:[/p][list][*][p]dust around areas of debris are now colored based on their resources (setup for future update)[/p][/*][*][p]thruster startup and shutdown animation[/p][/*][*][p]Improved onboarding and general explanation of the game[/p][/*][*][p]various UI fixes, for example disabled buttons, animations and sounds[/p][/*][*][p]various bugs with[/p][list][*][p]station editor[/p][/*][*][p]drone editor[/p][/*][*][p]story [/p][/*][*][p]BigScreen™[/p][/*][*][p]Manual[/p][p]have been found and fixed[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Planned things to come:[/p][list][*][p]Automated bases, that can be deployed at various locations, that require your resource managing skills[/p][/*][*][p]Better visuals
Especially during the night, the objects should look more in line with the scene[/p][/*][*][p]Better Camera movement[/p][/*][*][p]Racing-inspired "tuning-section": your drone will always be there and you can tinker on it before taking a flight[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: In-Game Manual
notes.notes: [p]As part of the better onboarding and better playing experience this update brings an in-game manual, currently just showing the 3-Letter-Codes and displaying the controls.[/p][p]In the future the manual should also show and describe all the different modules for the drone and station.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]already known issues:[/p][list][*][p]Editing the Station does not work correctly sometimes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Story might not work out, in that some events might soft-lock your progression, the events might not trigger correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes collisions are not detected.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Better Onboarding
notes.notes:
[p]Because many players raised concerns about the (onboarding) experience for players that are not regular space-game players, for example regarding the 3-letter codes.
Now instead of only showing the 3-letter code, when [b]hovering[/b] over one there should be the [b]full text[/b] displayed.[/p][p]The onboarding story now explains a lot more details, reasons and terminology.[/p][p][/p][p]Some minor improvements include:[/p][list][*][p]Rewrite of all Story Events[/p][/*][*][p]The onboarding should now be more smooth and explain a lot more than previously[/p][/*][*][p]Revised Opening animation of BigScreen™[/p][/*][*][p]Some fixes to the Story Events and system[/p][/*][*][p]updated Logo[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Known issues:[/p][list][*][p][b]Not all[/b] 3-letter codes may be explained at the moment[/p][/*][*][p]This new system may [b]not[/b] work [b]everywhere[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]already known issues:[/p][list][*][p]Editing the Station does not work correctly sometimes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Story might not work out, in that some events might soft-lock your progression, the events might not trigger correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes collisions are not detected.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Story and dangerous grabbing
notes.notes: [p]This time [b]Story Events[/b] have been added so you can enjoy the first few events of the story.[/p][p]But watch out, [b]Grabbing[/b] is now [b]dangerous[/b]! You'll need to adapt your relative speed to the debris you want to pickup, otherwise the grabber gets damaged.[/p][p][/p][p]Some minor improvements include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Damage model[/b] revised, but still some problems are known.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for [b]UI[/b] and small visual improvements/tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]The game pauses while displaying messages, to avoid creating unfair scenarios, where the drone would leave the signal radius[/p][/*][*][p]BigScreen™ handling was improved in some edge cases[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Known issues:[/p][list][*][p]Editing the Station does not work correctly sometimes.[/p][/*][*][p]The Story might not work out, in that some events might soft-lock your progression, the events might not trigger correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes collisions are not detected.[/p][/*][/list]
